tools.name: accession_submit
tools.description: Submit one crop-germplasm accession metadata value with its exact collecting-station literal. The required legacy probe returns a TypeCorrectionRequired result containing the seed-bank gateway's received typed value and authoritative suggested typed value/literal. Submit that suggestion once to obtain a signed germplasm intake receipt.

value.description: The actual JSON value. Preserve its intended JSON type; do not stringify numbers, booleans, or null.

literal.description: The exact source or suggested JSON literal token represented by value, including required quote characters.
